# AWS User Group Kolkata (AWSUGKOL)

> Official AWS User Group in Kolkata, India. An independent, volunteer-led technical community for cloud architects, developers, and engineers.

## About

AWS User Group Kolkata (AWSUGKOL) is a community-led group established in 2016, serving 3,000+ cloud enthusiasts across Kolkata, India. We host meetups, workshops, hands-on labs, and annual AWS Community Days focused on cloud architecture, serverless, GenAI, DevOps, and enterprise scalability.

This is an independent community — not officially affiliated with Amazon Web Services, Inc.

## Key Facts

- Community size: 3,000+ Meetup members, 2,000+ LinkedIn followers
- Events hosted: 80+ technical meetups, workshops, and Community Days
- Established: August 2016
- Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India (hybrid events)
- Focus areas: AWS Cloud, Serverless, GenAI/Bedrock, DevOps, CDK, Security
- 10th Anniversary: August 5, 2026

## Leadership

- Soumyadeep Mandal — Community Leader & Organizer (since 2018)
